description: One bank against its peers in a quarter (default latest): value, peer median, quartiles and percentile rank for efficiency_ratio, roa_ytd, net_interest_margin_ytd and noninterest_income_share. Percentile rank is the share of peers at or below the bank's value; for efficiency_ratio lower is better. Give the FDIC certificate number (find_bank looks it up by name). peer_basis: 'size_band' (default; bands by quarter-end assets: 1 = under $100M, 2 = $100M-$500M, 3 = $500M-$1B, 4 = $1B-$10B, 5 = $10B+), 'state' (same-state banks), or 'size_band_and_state'. Ratios are fractions on year-to-date flows (roa_ytd and net_interest_margin_ytd annualized over average assets, re-basing each January). For credit unions use peer_compare.
name: bank_peer_compare
